name: Adani Power Ltd
title: Adani Power Ltd - 533096 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Adani Power's Q4 FY26 PLF was 74% and FY26 PLF 66.5%, with 95% of operating capacity tied to PPAs and capex guided to INR25,000 crore in FY27, though Mahan and Korba timelines slipped and merchant exposure fell to 5%.

utilisation.quote: Consolidated PLF for Q4 remained healthy at 74%. On an annual basis, this is 66.5%

capex.quote: we are taking a conservative approach because certain things, as I said earlier, the issue of availability of workforce

triggers.label: Mahan 1.6 GW pushed toward FY28
triggers.quote: we are moving this 1.6 gigawatt of Mahan to the next year

triggers.label: Merchant realisation volatile; PPA ~INR5.5
triggers.quote: Under PPA, you have surety that you will get, let's say, INR5.5 or so. Whereas in case of merchant, nowadays, you are getting INR7, INR8 also and sometimes you are getting INR3.

triggers.label: Peak demand 256 GW, revival from March
triggers.quote: Peak demand has recently reached 256 gigawatts, and it is expected to rise further in the current year.

triggers.label: Merchant share 16% → 5%
triggers.quote: in the beginning of the year, we were at 16% merchant capacity

guidance.value: Unit 1 in Q2 FY27, unit 2 before year-end
guidance.quote: The first unit will be in the second quarter of this year, and the second unit will get commissioned before the year-end.

guidance.value: by end FY27, at most Q1 FY28
guidance.quote: One unit, yes, we are targeting by the end of this year. If the geopolitical situation continues for a longer time, then at the most, it can go to the first quarter of the next year.
capex for FY26-27 will be near about INR25,000 crores, for our expansion.
For FY27-'28, it will be near about INR33,000 crores.
we should be in a position to achieve INR50,000 crore conservatively by FY 2031.
we are confident that by FY31-32 our capacity will be 42 gigawatt from a planned capacity.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Capacity additions of 2.9 GW in FY27 and 2.4 GW in FY28
prior_guidance_check.quote: now seem to have revised that downwards with FY27 only being 1.32, FY28 only being 1.6

red_flags.label: Net debt rising to INR45,022 crore
red_flags.quote: The increase in leverage primarily reflects planned bridge financing for ongoing capex.

red_flags.label: Bangladesh receivable dispute unresolved
red_flags.quote: we have appointed an expert who is going to hear both the parties soon.

red_flags.label: Borrowing cost ~8%
red_flags.quote: the rate getting from the market, is about 8%,and its either DCM or from domestic banks.

evasions.quote: It would not be fair to say in advance that whether you will get realization better in merchant or the PPA.
No, we have not signed during FY26.
